title: The Timer That Fell Behind: QTimer Intervals, a Blocked Loop and the Ticks Nobody Counted
fallback: This lesson is about QTimer and the event loop, so it needs Qt. Lesson 07-08 builds the same fixed grid with a pacer in plain C++, and lesson 07-16 measures a loop built on it. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a ticker that keeps a fixed grid of slots on a QTimer and reports the slots a blocked loop skipped
